game_title: Nested While Dungeon – Whispering Corridor Defense
game_concept: A action defense set in Shadow Cave – Whispering Corridor, a whispering corridor: the lantern keeper must handle giant bats while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Nested While Dungeon: Run an inner loop for each room inside an outer loop for each floor.
theme: Shadow Cave – Whispering Corridor: a whispering corridor
core_gameplay_loop: In Whispering Corridor, repeat each round: Run an inner loop for each room inside an outer loop for each floor. Each round, giant bats strike the mine cart, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the dungeon_clear value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the mine cart from giant bats in Whispering Corridor: keep the dungeon_clear meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 57-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: dungeon_clear drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 57-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 10 (extended tier): Nested While Dungeon
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Nested While Dungeon' (Week 4 slot 15), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Whispering Corridor'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how dungeon_clear changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against giant bats in Whispering Corridor.
